name: Doorless House
description: A small house stands in the middle of a field, with windows, a chimney, and perfectly smooth walls.

scenes.name: Lit Window
scenes.description: A cozy room is visible through the glass, but its furniture sometimes changes position.

scenes.name: Cold Chimney
scenes.description: Smoke rises from the chimney, although the bricks are completely cold.

scenes.name: Tracks by the Wall
scenes.description: A trail of tiny tracks ends right at the house's blank wall.
